review_candidates.title: Founding Account Executive Factorial AI Education
review_candidates.description: Hello! 👋 I’m Carmen from Factorial, and I’m looking for a Founding Account Executive to help bring Factorial Campus, our brand new AI Education business line , to the Spanish Market. This is a role for an AI-obsessed, entrepreneurial B2B seller who wants more than an established pipeline and a finished playbook. You’ll help us win our first customers, validate how we sell and build the foundations for growth, starting in Spain, with Europe in sight. This is a 0 to 1 position so you’ll work full cycle doing whatever it takes to make: from generating pipeline to closing. You’ll be part of the founding sales team of this new venture. Exciting, right? About The Team 👥 Factorial Campus is our new education product for companies, starting with practical programs that help teams adopt AI in their daily work . Think of the as bootcamps or masters, but for companies teams. If you love the thrill of building real relationships and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future of AI Education, this is your place. Our mission is to multiply European workers potential by helping them adopt AI on a daily basis at work. The role + What you’ll do 🚀 At the beginning, you’ll own the full sales cycle , from creating opportunities to closing customers. As the team grows, you’ll work alongside SDRs, but you’ll always be comfortable generating your own pipeline. You will: Win our first customers: Prospect, discover, demo, negotiate and close. Build the sales motion: Test our ICP, messaging, qualification criteria and sales process through real conversations. Create pipeline: Use inbound, outbound, partnerships and whichever creative channels actually work. Sell through value: Help companies understand how AI education can create real business impact. Shape the offer: Turn customer feedback into actionable insights for the Campus, Marketing and Product teams. Use AI as a teammate: Delegate research, preparation, follow-ups, reporting and other meaningful work to AI. In addition, this position requires you to speak Spanish proficiently, you’ll be selling to Spanish clients. Why you should join 🤝🏽 A genuine 0-to-1 challenge: Your work will help define how Factorial Campus is sold and scaled. Real impact: You won’t just follow a playbook—you’ll help write it based on deals you’ve personally won. Build at the forefront of AI adoption: Help companies turn AI into real impact while developing expertise in one of today’s most valuable and fast-moving spaces. Multi-market ambition: Start by proving the model in Spain and help prepare it for other European markets. Entrepreneurial experience inside Factorial: The excitement of building something new, with the support of an established European SaaS company. What are we looking for? 🎯 Don’t be discouraged if you don’t check every box: A strong B2B seller: You’ve owned and closed sales opportunities, ideally in SaaS, technology or another consultative environment. Entrepreneurial mindset: You’re energized by ambiguity, default to action and create structure where little exists. Full-cycle attitude: You’re happy to generate pipeline as well as close it—especially while we build the initial motion. AI-first way of working: You already delegate meaningful parts of your work to it and continuously experiment with new ways to improve your performance. Excellent communication: You can turn a new and complex topic into a clear, compelling business case. Native Spanish and professional English. Selling Education experience is a plus: Experience selling corporate training, education or upskilling solutions would be highly valued. Bonus if you have ✨ Experience using CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Experience in Sales or B2B within a SaaS or digital transformation environment. Knowledge of qualification methodologies that nurture curiosity, urgency and intent. Perks of being part of Factorial 😎 High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 🤝 Healthy life with Wellhub (Gyms, pools, outdoor classes) 🕺🏻 Save expenses with Cobee💰 Language classes 👩🏻‍🏫 Breakfast in the office and organic fruit 🍏 Food discounts with Nora 🍱 Pet Friendly 🐕 Much more that we'll spill during the interview process About Factorial 🚀 Founded in Barcelona in 2016, we now have +1,700 employees serving more than 16,000 companies across 112 countries. Factorial started with a simple idea: companies were spending too much time managing processes and not enough time doing the work they were hired to do: their best work. But as companies grow, work gets more disconnected. More people, more tools, more information, and more time spent connecting the dots. Generic AI can answer questions, but it doesn’t know your company. Every time, you have to give it the context. Factorial is different. Because it’s inside the company, it already knows how it works, including its people, processes, policies, and data. So you can ask it to do real work, from screening candidates and managing expenses to answering questions and creating reports. AI isn’t the goal. Giving people back their time is. Factorial is the AI for Business that knows companies, connects how work happens across the business, and turns that context into action. When work changes, so do we. We believe in diverse talent: we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply. We believe in inclusion: we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you. Our values 🫀 We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses. We learn and teach: We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it. We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other. We grow fast: We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them. Want to learn more about us? Check our website!
